description:
You are a cartographer at a geographic publishing firm preparing a simplified world regions base map for use in a regional development atlas. The client requires continent-level polygon boundaries rather than individual country outlines — all countries within each continent must be merged into a single continental geometry.

Using gvSIG Desktop and the countries layer at /home/ga/gvsig_data/countries/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp, dissolve all country features by the CONTINENT attribute field so that each distinct continent value becomes a single (multi)polygon feature. Export the dissolved result as a new shapefile to /home/ga/gvsig_exports/continents_dissolved.shp.

The output must contain one feature per distinct CONTINENT value found in the source data, with the CONTINENT field preserved in the output attributes.
